title: Execute guard-to-diagnostic-to-compensation failure-path integration tests
scope: SD.md D3 only. Executable failure-path integration tests covering guard-to-diagnostic-to-compensation with real subprocesses and isolated lease/bootstrap/SSH/HTTP fixtures. D1-D2 were delivered in DEV502-CAPTURE-001. D4-D6 (hosted TRACE/RCA, product FIX, durable diagnostics) and step 5 belong to follow-on tasks. Local fixtures are not hosted runtime proof.

d3_1_baseline_success.requirement: Baseline success does not execute failure collector
verifications: Real guard executable scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh exits 0
Guard failure file is not created
SSH execution log confirms baseline ran and collector was never invoked
collection-status.json records collectionStatus='not_required', bootstrapExit=0, collectorExit=0
diagnostics.json is not created
Heartbeat process remains healthy throughout

d3_2_baseline_exit1_capture_before_heart.requirement: Baseline exit 1: capture precedes heartbeat stop; outer guard exits 75 and records original exit 1
verifications: Timing probe during collector execution proves heartbeat process is ALIVE
Timing probe during collector execution proves guard failure file does NOT exist yet
Outer guard terminates with exit 75
Guard failure file records original baseline exitStatus=1
Diagnostics directory contains valid diagnostics.json, matching SHA256SUMS, and collectionStatus='ok'
Guard cleanup stops heartbeat for quarantine

d3_3_collector_failure_paths.requirement: Collector timeout, command exit, and corrupted JSON: bootstrap failure exit preserved, rollback reachable
verifications: Collector timeout (deadline exceeded) preserves original bootstrap exit 1, records collectionStatus='timeout', invokes fresh-lease compensation, and releases recovered lease
Collector error exit (exit 2, ssh error) preserves bootstrap exit 1, records collectorErrorCategory='collector_command_failed', invokes compensation, and releases recovered lease
Corrupted JSON output preserves bootstrap exit 1, records collectionStatus='invalid_json', cleans up broken artifact files, invokes compensation, and releases recovered lease

d3_4_heartbeat_and_cas_loss.requirement: Heartbeat or remote CAS loss: command process group terminated including all descendants, no further remote command runs
verifications: Mid-command heartbeat loss triggers guard fail_guarded_command; terminates COMMAND_PGID and all descendant processes; guard exits 75; collector never runs
Remote CAS verification failure triggers guard fail_guarded_command; terminates COMMAND_PGID and all descendant processes; guard exits 75; collector invocation markers never appear in SSH logs

d3_5_cancellation_and_identity_mismatch_.requirement: Cancellation, missing/expired state, wrong source, ambiguous containers fail closed
verifications: Real signal injection (SIGTERM exit 143, SIGINT exit 130) while bootstrap is active terminates process group immediately without collector
Real signal injection (SIGTERM exit 143) while collector is active terminates process group and background child descendants immediately
Missing lease token, missing state file, or missing wrapper env variables fail closed with exit 75 before command execution
Expired lease state fails closed with exit 75 before command execution, preventing remote execution
Candidate source SHA mismatch fails closed with collectionStatus='identity_mismatch' without declaring false success
Ambiguous container match fails closed with collectionStatus='identity_mismatch' and schema compliance

d3_6_artifact_output_verification.requirement: Artifact output missing, upload failure, or bad checksum cannot declare diagnostic acceptance
verifications: Missing collection-status.json, non-ok status, missing diagnostics.json, missing SHA256SUMS, or corrupted checksum fails acceptance
Runner upload failure or runner corrupted payload simulates artifact loss and blocks downstream acceptance declaration

d3_7_project_exceptions_and_secret_senti.requirement: Project domain exceptions and Persona owner positively captured via real collector stdin execution; secret sentinels never leak
verifications: Positive capture of services.control_plane.bff.ports.persona_write_owner.PersonaWriteOwnerUnavailable through real collector execution over stdin
Positive capture of services.control_plane.bff.persona_provisioning.ProvisioningLeaseLost
Positive capture of standard exceptions (e.g. ConnectionRefusedError)
Zero leakage of sensitive sentinels (tokens, passwords, DSNs, JWTs) across diagnostics.json, collection-status.json, and SHA256SUMS

d3_8_compensation_independent_outcomes.requirement: Composed baseline failure -> capture -> quarantine -> runner artifact handling -> fresh-lease compensation with independent primary and compensation exit codes and lease state assertions
verifications: Composed failure: primary exit 75, Lease 1 quarantined in state authority audit, artifacts produced, compensation under fresh Lease 2 succeeds (exit 0) and releases Lease 2
Composed failure with compensation failure: primary exit 75, Lease 1 quarantined, compensation under fresh Lease 2 fails (exit 75), leaving both leases in quarantined state
